title: Add DO-NOT-DEVIATE warning to decider.md Step A attention-inbox schema block
background: ISS-2661 (moderate, pipeline-schema-drift): analyst-baby verified decider's attention-inbox writer was emitting {id:ATTN-NNN, resolved:boolean, subject, detail} instead of canonical schema {id:ATT-<ISO-timestamp>, status:'pending', reason}. ATTN-002/003 were invisible to analyst Mode 2b dispatcher because the filter is status-based only. Analyst Mode 6 already cleaned the inbox (2026-06-07T23:15Z). EXP-605 (analyst-baby) documented findings in monitor/analyst/expansions/EXP-605-baby-batch-1.json. ISS-2661 routing_reason: 'prompt-level fix needed in decider.md Step A — route to tinker'.
requested_work: In monitor/prompts/decider.md Step A, immediately before the attention-inbox JSON schema block, add: '**DO NOT DEVIATE from this schema.** Writing {id:ATTN-NNN, resolved:boolean} instead breaks analyst Mode 2b dispatch — ATTN items are invisible to the dispatcher.'
Optional: harden analyst.md Mode 2b filter to also accept resolved===false as a fallback.
Optional: add archive-before-remove guidance to Step A so cleared items flow to attention-inbox-archive.jsonl.
After editing prompts: manually copy decider.md to FUSE workspace (dome-mirror propagates within ~30min but manual copy is safe bootstrap).

Lifecycle: flip this directive to status='completed' with completed_at/completed_by_run. Close ISS-2661 in closed-issues.json with status='fixed', fixed_by='tinker-directive', closure_resolution='DO-NOT-DEVIATE warning added to decider.md Step A per DIRECTIVE-20260608-001'.
non_goals: Do NOT change the canonical schema itself — it is already correct in decider.md Step A.
Do NOT re-process ATTN-002/003 — analyst Mode 6 already handled them.
Do NOT widen scope to other attention-inbox consumers.
